business_summary: Genius Sports Limited (NYSE: GENI) is a UK-headquartered sports-data and technology company. Its one sourced role on this chain is official-event-data: its FY2025 Form 20-F discloses that a substantial portion of its offerings use sports properties acquired under rights granted by sports organizations, including sports data and streaming rights, the same official-feed layer both sportsbooks and prediction-market venues buy from.

exposure_summary.narrative: Genius holds one sourced role on prediction-market-plumbing: official-event-data (EMERGING, chain position 1). FY2025 revenue grew to USD 669.5M (25.2% three-year CAGR) but the company remains loss-making (net loss USD 111.6M, operating margin -22.6%); operating cash flow is nonetheless positive (USD 86.4M, FCF margin 9.6%, against a negative operating-cash-flow-to-net-income ratio driven purely by the negative net-income denominator). Piotroski (7, STRONG) and Beneish (-3.392, CLEAN) both score cleanly on 9/9 and 12/12 inputs. Net debt to EBITDA is not written: FY2025 operating income is negative and the EBITDA proxy (operating income plus depreciation) is therefore negative too, making a debt/EBITDA ratio not a meaningful leverage read despite Genius holding more cash than debt.
